headerInfo.topicName: Assembly Line 3 - Pneumatic Crimper Pressure Drop Detection Alarm
headerInfo.attendees: RAHUL SHARMA, Production Supv, QA Auditor

rows.observation: Secondary lock on 16-pin connector cavity #3 not seating flush with housing.
rows.rootCause: Guide rib flash burr on molding batch #B24.
rows.counterMeasure: Trimmed molding flash and adjusted jig insertion guide from 15° to 22°.

rows.observation: Barcode sticker placement on fuse cover shifted by 4mm beyond boundary mark.
rows.rootCause: Locator dowel pin on pneumatic label applicator had 0.5mm axial play.
rows.counterMeasure: Tightened locator dowel pin and installed reference laser positioning line.

rows.observation: Terminal pin insertion click sound not audible during high-speed cycle.
rows.rootCause: Operator wearing dual-layer work gloves dampening tactile feedback.
rows.counterMeasure: Standardized single-layer ergonomic gloves and installed acoustic sensor buzzer.

rows.observation: Grommet sealing tape wrapping overlap pitch inconsistent on Station 2.
rows.rootCause: Manual tape dispenser tension spool spring worn out.
rows.counterMeasure: Replaced tension spool with preset constant-torque dispenser mechanism.

rows.observation: Ground terminal eyelet screw torque lower than 4.5 Nm specification.
rows.rootCause: Pneumatic air line pressure fluctuation during simultaneous air blower use.
rows.counterMeasure: Installed dedicated auxiliary pressure regulator tank on pneumatic circuit.

rows.observation: Continuity buzzer latency over 400ms on multi-meter testing harness.
rows.rootCause: Test probe pogo-pin tip oxidation and high contact resistance.
rows.counterMeasure: Instituted daily gold-plated pogo pin cleaning cycle with isopropyl alcohol.

rows.observation: Protective corrugated tube sleeve end slippage before connector boot.
rows.rootCause: Cable tie tension setting on handheld gun calibrated too loose (level 3).
rows.counterMeasure: Locked cable tie tension setting to level 5 with tamper-evident seal.

rows.observation: Work station illumination level under 450 Lux at crimping junction.
rows.rootCause: LED overhead diffuser cover covered in ambient airborne dust.
rows.counterMeasure: Cleaned diffuser and replaced standard LED tube with 800 Lux high-CRI fixture.

rows.observation: Pre-sorting tray part partition label faded and difficult to read.
rows.rootCause: Solvent wipe cleaning removed thermal printed text.
rows.counterMeasure: Applied laminated acrylic barcode label covers with UV solvent resistance.

rows.observation: Visual inspection board sample reference harness missing current rev stamp.
rows.rootCause: Engineering change notice (ECN #108) update was not posted on line display.
rows.counterMeasure: Audited line display boards and affixed current revision master sample tag.

headerInfo.topicName: C&C Area - CNC Milling Center #3 Spindle Runout Laser Alignment Audit
headerInfo.attendees: MANISH JOSHI, Production Supv, QA Auditor

rows.observation: Plunger tip lubrication oil flow rate exceeding set parameter by 18%.
rows.rootCause: Spray nozzle solenoid valve seat worn out causing minor weepage.
rows.counterMeasure: Replaced solenoid seat and installed flow rate turbine sensor interlock.

rows.observation: Trimming press upper die shear blade burr height reaching 0.12mm (limit 0.08mm).
rows.rootCause: Die cutting edge clearance increased due to guide pillar bushing wear.
rows.counterMeasure: Sharpened trimming die blade and replaced bronze guide bushings.

rows.observation: Shot blasting steel grit circulation density dropping after 2 hours operation.
rows.rootCause: Bucket elevator drive belt slip causing low recirculation volume.
rows.counterMeasure: Adjusted belt tensioner pulley and calibrated optical belt speed sensor.

rows.observation: Cast aluminium bracket cooling water temperature outlet above 65°C.
rows.rootCause: Chilled water inlet plate heat exchanger partially clogged with mineral scale.
rows.counterMeasure: Acid flushed heat exchanger and boosted chiller circulation pump flow rate.

rows.observation: Die casting hydraulic accumulator pressure drop rate during shot phase 2.
rows.rootCause: Nitrogen bladder pre-charge pressure dropped below 90 bar.
rows.counterMeasure: Recharged nitrogen gas to 110 bar and verified dual check-valve integrity.

rows.observation: CNC milling machine spindle vibration level 2.8 mm/s on finish facing pass.
rows.rootCause: Tool holder BT40 taper contact area under 70% with spindle socket.
rows.counterMeasure: Blue-dye matched tool taper and blued spindle taper to achieve 90% contact.

rows.observation: Deburring station operator safety light curtain beam alignment offset.
rows.rootCause: Forklift pallet impact near perimeter guard fence frame.
rows.counterMeasure: Realigned emitter-receiver brackets and installed heavy-duty steel safety bollard.

rows.observation: Degreasing wash tank ultrasonic transducer output cavitation low.
rows.rootCause: Piezoelectric transducer drive cable terminal screw loose.
rows.counterMeasure: Torqued wiring terminal and ran frequency sweep calibration at 28 kHz.

rows.observation: Die surface temperature infrared pyrometer sensor reading erratic.
rows.rootCause: Smoke residue deposition on optical protective sapphire lens.
rows.counterMeasure: Mounted continuous dry air-purge nozzle over sensor lens housing.

rows.observation: Molding scrap bin overflow warning beacon buzzer failed to sound.
rows.rootCause: Capacitive proximity bin-level sensor sensitivity potentiometer drift.
rows.counterMeasure: Recalibrated capacitive level sensor and added audio-visual horn beacon.
